title: Japan Cultural Tales: Tokyo to Hiroshima
alt: Himeji castle, the white heron keep, Japan
transport: Bullet trains, coaches and guided touring throughout

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Large four star hotel beside Shinagawa station

activities.name: Tokyo sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day through the city, from the Meiji shrine and the Imperial Palace gardens to the old temple lanes of Asakusa.

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: Two nights beside Shinagawa station, with free time in Shinjuku and a full guided city day.

stops.name: Kyoto
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel opposite Kyoto station, handy for the trains

activities.name: Kyoto sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day through the old capital, taking in the golden pavilion, a Zen garden and the torii gate paths above Fushimi.

program.name: Kyoto
program.description: A night in the old capital with a guided afternoon and free time in the Gion lanes.

stops.name: Osaka
stops.subtitle: Osaka to Nara
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel in Namba with a rooftop bath house

activities.name: Nara sightseeing tour
activities.description: Todai-ji with its great bronze Buddha, the lantern lined Kasuga shrine and the deer park on the walk between them.

program.name: Osaka
program.description: A night in Namba, reached through Nara's temples and deer park, with the food streets on your doorstep.

stops.name: Okayama
stops.subtitle: Okayama to Himeji
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel in central Okayama, near the Korakuen garden

activities.name: Himeji castle
activities.description: The white heron castle, the finest surviving fortress in Japan and the first site here to be listed by UNESCO.

activities.name: Okayama sightseeing tour
activities.description: The Korakuen garden, counted among the three great gardens of Japan, and the black keep of Okayama castle beside it.

program.name: Okayama
program.description: A night in Okayama, with Himeji castle on the way west and the Korakuen garden in the afternoon.

stops.name: Hiroshima
stops.subtitle: Hiroshima to Kurashiki and Miyajima
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel in the centre, walking distance from the park

activities.name: Kurashiki canal quarter
activities.description: Free time in the old merchant quarter, where white walled storehouses line a willow canal that still has punts on it.

activities.name: Hiroshima walking tour
activities.description: On foot through the Peace Memorial Park, the cenotaph and the A-Bomb Dome with a guide who tells the city's story properly.

activities.name: Itsukushima shrine
activities.description: The ferry to Miyajima for the shrine built out over the water, with its torii gate standing in the sea at high tide.

program.name: Hiroshima
program.description: A last night in Hiroshima, with Kurashiki's canal quarter on the way and the island shrine at Miyajima the same day.

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: One direction, five towns and four star hotels all the way. Travelling west by train is the easiest way to see old Japan.
expert.tip: The Candeo in Namba has a rooftop bath house. After a day with the Nara deer it is the best twenty minutes of the trip.

summary: Seven days west from Tokyo: two nights in Shinagawa with a guided city day, a night in Kyoto, Nara's temples on the way to Osaka, Himeji castle with Okayama's Korakuen garden, then Hiroshima with Kurashiki and the island shrine at Miyajima.
included: Included: 6 nights across five towns with daily breakfast in four star hotels; bullet trains and coaches throughout; guided sightseeing in Tokyo, Kyoto, Nara, Okayama and Hiroshima; Himeji castle entry; free time at Kurashiki; the ferry and visit to Itsukushima shrine.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
